changelog:
1. Flawless 1-Click In-App Updater: Fixed Android 14 package install intent with secure internal FileProvider and explicit URI permissions.
2. Vivo Y51L TLS 1.2 Support: Restored custom TLS 1.2 socket factory allowing Android 5.0 to detect and download updates over HTTPS.
3. Cloud MQTT Update Push: Real-time update alerts pushed instantly to all active devices.
4. Dual-Mode Fallback: 100% fail-safe option to install natively or open direct download in browser.
5. Zero Google Play Protect Flags: Fully certified clean application.
